references.text: Both verses express God's will to preserve all who are given to Jesus and promise resurrection on the last day.
Jesus directly links faith in Him to eternal life and resurrection, paralleling the requirement to see and believe in the Son's role in John 6:40.
Here it is confirmed that whoever hears God's word and believes in the One who sent Him has eternal life and will not come into judgment but has passed from death to life.
Jesus emphasizes that His words will judge those who do not believe, and that He Himself will raise them up on the last day, a theme central to John 6:40.
The prophecy that the dead will rise and those who sleep in the dust will awaken is the prophetic background for the promise of resurrection on the last day.
Daniel predicts a resurrection for both those who will receive eternal life and those who will face eternal shame, reflecting Jesus' promise of eternal life to believers.
